Orchard Station is connected to Orchard Ion shopping mall, Wisma Atria, CK Tang, Marriott at Tang and Wheelock Place.  Essentially it's covered walkway from Orchard Station to these places and also to Takashimaya - Wisma Atria and Takashimaya are connected in Basement 1.  Orchard Station has 2 lines - North South Line (red) and Thomson Eastern Line (TEL) - serves well for those staying in the north and the in the east.  As Orchard is a busy area, the station tends to be crowded.  Needs Patience to queue for escalator.  More signage on which direction to go for the respective buildings will make it easier for commuters and tourists.
